issues: The original child-count chapter uses fruitful fifth/eleventh planets and fertile sign labels, with double-count for bicorporeal and triple-count for fruitful signs. A sign can be in both categories and the original supplies no disambiguating precedence.
The source predicts a number of children, not precisely defined legal offspring, biological live births, fetal losses, surviving or cared-for children, adoption, or adult dependants.

Child-sex rules impose planet, zodiac house, sign and degree masculine classifications, while Moon/Venus feminine predicates also require occidental status. These traditional labels have no reproductive biology validity.
The separate claimed longevity/fame/happiness, obedience and parental profit outcomes cannot substitute for actual child numbers.
The father's relationship with child is alleged from favorable/hostile aspects between first and fifth house lords, without longitudinal dyad records or validated relationship measurement.
The attributed Albubater aphorisms allege early child death, no offspring remaining, death order versus parent and malefic aspects. They are not independently collated with original Albubater text.
Several glyphs in Saturn/Mercury/Sun Taurus Midheaven and later fifth-ruler sign/aspect branches are uncertain, not operationally executable.
The author attributes a rival tenth, eleventh, fourth and fifth house method to Ptolemy and says later authors differed. This attribution has not been independently verified against original Ptolemy.
The chosen contemporary fifth-house priority from prior unnumbered source therefore must not be silently represented as Ptolemy's independent confirming method.
No verified natal charts or birth times, registered pregnancies and births, sex ratios, child survival records, mortality denominators or independently blinded comparisons are supplied.
No human clinical, reproductive, child mortality or family therapy recommendations may be made from period astrological claims.
The next immediate source is the separate unnumbered ninth-house travel/religion introduction on PDF640 before next printed numbered CHAP CXXXIX on the SAME page.
Source integrity and photographic verification do not validate astrology's predictive success or create a runtime rule.
The extraction selectively paraphrases qualified historical content; not a diplomatic original glyph-by-glyph publication.
